description: A React functional component named Card that renders a styled card UI element with optional header, subheader, actions, and content areas. It supports themes via CSS classes and accepts various props for customization.

methods.name: Card({ title, subtitle, actions, children, className = "", ariaLabel, variant = "brown", })
methods.description: React functional component for rendering a styled card element with optional header, subtitle, actions, and content. Applies styling based on variant and className props.

parameters.title: string or React node for the card's title
parameters.subtitle: string or React node for the card's subtitle
parameters.actions: React nodes representing action buttons or links
parameters.children: React nodes for main card content
parameters.variant: string indicating style variant, defaults to 'brown'
